basis: All twelve HQ counterexamples were reproduced against this branch's owner BEFORE repair; all twelve reproduced exactly.

Reproduction found one counterexample worse than those HQ listed: a genuine NEGATIVE receipt wrapped in a hand-built AdmissionEvaluation asserting ADMITTED minted a POSITIVE route obligation. That laundering is now closed.

Each typed factory now requires the EXACT competent current owner object family by type identity, never by isinstance and never by duck typing. A caller-shaped object with plausible fields and exact-looking refs cannot mint governed projection or route material.
Exact type identity also refuses a caller-defined subclass, so the gate cannot be bypassed by inheritance.
The owner label is now fixed by the factory in all six projection/obligation factories plus both exact refusal factories; no owner= parameter survives anywhere.

from_adaptive_result no longer accepts producer_ref; the determinant ref comes only from AdaptiveSearchResult.determinant_state_ref, and the exact owner checkpoint, visited and unvisited refs are still preserved.
RecursiveCoverageCustody.from_handoff no longer accepts required_supporting_refs; the custody is a pure function of the real handoff and admits no caller evidence.

The canonical StructuralEmpiricalAdmission receipt is now the sole authority for every route fact. The AdmissionEvaluation is accepted only as an execution envelope whose duplicate fields agree exactly; any disagreement fails closed.
For ADMITTED, contradictory requested-use metadata is rejected outright rather than stored beside the receipt truth.
For a nonpositive unresolved receipt the exact UNRESOLVED_STRUCTURAL_USE target is preserved and the obligation gains no positive route authority.

No semantic design was reopened and no R1/R2 valid work was regressed. No R1 or R2 court was deleted; two were rewritten in place because their original code depended on a removed caller channel, and each rewrite is strictly stronger.
The prior 185 remains valid and passing; 14 hostiles added for 199 passed, 0 failed, 0 errors, 0 skipped.
next_required_action: Narrow independent rereview of the three C1-03A factory-authenticity blockers (E, F, G), with particular attention to whether receipt-truth dominance plus envelope agreement fully closes positive laundering from a hand-built AdmissionEvaluation.
